title: 劳工管理
summary: 评估公司劳动关系管理的质量，包括员工满意度、流动率、薪酬公平及劳动力管理政策。

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Labor Management Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Labor Management is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the complexity of their workforce (size, labor intensity and regions of operation), the relationship between management and labor, the strength of worker protections, and their employee engagement efforts.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍劳工管理关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。劳工管理属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖员工队伍的复杂性（规模、劳动密集程度及运营地域）、劳资关系、劳动者保护力度，以及员工参与措施。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_cn: 劳工管理关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Labor Management Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue Score.
blocks.content_cn: 劳工管理关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

blocks.content: The Labor Management Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the company's workforce eligible for an employee stock ownership plan or employee stock purchase plan.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司员工中符合员工持股计划或员工购股计划参与条件的覆盖范围。

sections.title_cn: • 有资格享受非薪酬福利的员工。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the company's workforce eligible for material non-compensation benefits. Best practice is to cover all employees. The indicative list of major non-compensation benefits includes: pension (defined benefit pension plan, substantial matching on defined contribution plan e.g., 401k), retirement plans (Simplified Employee Pension Individual Retirement Account (SEP IRA), etc.), housing (employer-provided or employer-paid), group insurance (health, dental, life etc.), disability income protection, tuition/certification reimbursement.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司员工中有资格享受重要非薪酬福利的覆盖范围。最佳实践是覆盖所有员工。主要非薪酬福利示例包括：养老金，如确定给付养老金计划、对 401k 等确定缴费计划提供较大额度配比缴费；退休计划，如简化雇员养老金个人退休账户（SEP IRA）等；雇主提供或支付的住房；团体保险，如健康、牙科及人寿保险；伤残收入保障；学费或认证费用报销。

sections.title_en: - Scope of workforce eligibility for variable performance-based component to pay.
sections.title_cn: • 有资格获得绩效浮动薪酬的员工覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether non-officer staff are eligible for variable performance-based pay, such as bonuses, and considers the scope of employees eligible for performance-based pay.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明非高级职员是否有资格获得奖金等基于绩效的浮动薪酬，并考察符合条件的员工覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: The frequency (if any) with which the company surveys its employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司开展员工调查的频率，如有。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has established clear policies for employees following a restructuring or layoff, such as offering severance pay or assistance with outplacement, reemployment or retraining.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否针对重组或裁员后的员工制定明确政策，例如提供离职补偿、转职安置、再就业或再培训支持。

sections.title_en: - Scope of skills and knowledge development training.
sections.title_cn: • 技能与知识发展培训的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the company's workforce covered by training (if any) that would provide an opportunity for an employee to move up or into a new role.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司员工中获得可支持晋升或转入新岗位的培训机会的覆盖范围，如有。

sections.title_en: • Support for degree programs or certifications for employees.
sections.title_cn: • 支持员工攻读学位或取得认证。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the company's workforce eligible for support in pursuing degree programs or new certifications through tuition or fees reimbursement, sabbaticals, etc.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司员工中有资格通过学费或费用报销、进修假等方式，获得攻读学位或取得新认证支持的覆盖范围。

sections.title_cn: 劳工管理风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Labor Management Exposure Score evaluates the company's exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the average of the Business and Company-Specific Exposure Scores, combined with the Geographic Exposure Score. The Geographic Exposure Score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure Score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business, Geographic and Company-Specific Exposure Scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure Score calculation :
blocks.content_cn: 劳工管理风险敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的风险敞口，以业务与公司特定风险敞口得分的平均值为基础，并结合地域风险敞口得分。地域风险敞口得分作为业务风险敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务、地域和公司特定风险敞口得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高风险，0 分对应最低风险。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.2 节“风险敞口分析”。风险敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ {L B M, i} = \frac {B U S _ {L B M , i} + C O M _ {L B M , i}}{2} (1 + 0. 1 (G E O _ {L B M, i} - 5))
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{LBM,i}$ is the Labor Management Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{LBM,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的劳工管理风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $BUS_{LBM,i}$ is the Business Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BUS_{LBM,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $GEO_{LBM,i}$ is the Geographic Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $GEO_{LBM,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的地域风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $COM_{LBM,i}$ is the Company-Specific Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $COM_{LBM,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的公司特定风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: The Business Exposure Score is a weighted average of the Business Segment Exposure Scores of a company's business segments. Scores are weighted by the proportion of a company's total assets in each business segment, $^{1}$ using the following formula to calculate the Business Exposure Score:

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $BSE_{LBM,j}$ is the Business Segment Exposure Score for business segment $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BSE_{LBM,j}$ 为业务分部 $j$ 的业务分部风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $w_{Asset,i,j}$ is the weight of business segment j for company i based on the contribution to total company assets.
blocks.content_cn: • $w_{Asset,i,j}$ 为公司 i 的业务分部 j 按其占公司总资产比例确定的权重。

blocks.content: \- $n_{i}$ is the number of business segments of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $n_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务分部数量。

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure Score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI ESG Research uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure Score. Each business activity score is determined by the Employee Revenue Score of the segment.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI ESG 研究使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。各业务活动得分由该分部的人均收入得分确定。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $RE_{j}$ is the Employee Revenue Score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $RE_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的人均收入得分。

blocks.content: The Employee Revenue Score of a business activity is calculated by using the five-year trailing average revenue per employee attributed to a given business segment, such that a lower revenue per employee gets a higher score. Business activities with lower revenue per employee tend to be more labor-intensive, resulting in a higher Business Segment Exposure Score.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的人均收入得分按归属于该业务分部的过去五年平均每名员工收入计算，人均收入越低，得分越高。人均收入较低的业务活动往往劳动密集程度较高，因此业务分部风险敞口得分也较高。

blocks.content_cn: • $GSE_{LBM,r}$ 为地区 $r$ 的地域分部风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $w_{Asset,i,r}$ is the weight of total assets in region $r$ for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $w_{Asset,i,r}$ 为地区 $r$ 的总资产对公司 $i$ 的权重。

blocks.content: \- $GSE_{LBM,c}$ is the Geographic Segment Exposure Score of country $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $GSE_{LBM,c}$ 为国家 $c$ 的地域分部风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: The Geographic Segment Exposure Score is determined by the Strikes and Lockouts Score for a country.
blocks.content_cn: 地域分部风险敞口得分由一国罢工与停工得分确定。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $SL_{c}$ is the Strikes and Lockouts Score in country $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $SL_{c}$ 为国家 $c$ 的罢工与停工得分。

blocks.content: The Strikes and Lockouts Score for a country is calculated using the trailing 10-year average number of strikes and lockouts for a given country. The higher the number of strikes and lockouts, the higher the score, with the score varying from 0 to 10.
blocks.content_cn: 一国罢工与停工得分按该国过去 10 年罢工与停工次数的平均值计算。次数越多，得分越高，范围为 0—10 分。

blocks.content: The Company-Specific Exposure Score is determined by a simple average of the Total Employees Score and the Layoffs Incidence Score.
blocks.content_cn: 公司特定风险敞口得分由员工总数得分与裁员发生情况得分的简单平均值确定。

blocks.content:
$$
C O M _ {L B M, i} = A v e r a g e \big (T E _ {L B M, i} + L I _ {L B M, i} \big)
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $COM_{LBM,i}$ is the Company-Specific Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $COM_{LBM,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的公司特定风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $TE_{LBM,i}$ is the Total Employees Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $TE_{LBM,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的员工总数得分。

blocks.content: \- $LI_{LBM,i}$ is the Layoffs Incidence Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $LI_{LBM,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的裁员发生情况得分。

blocks.content: The Total Employees Score is derived from the total number of employees of a company.
blocks.content_cn: 员工总数得分根据公司员工总人数确定。

blocks.content: The Layoffs Incidence Score for a given company is calculated from the number of layoffs in the last three years. A score of 10 is assessed if layoffs affect more than $10\%$ of the company's workforce or more than 1,000 employees. Otherwise the Layoffs Incidence Score is not assessed, and the Company-Specific Exposure Score is determined solely based on the Total Employees Score.
blocks.content_cn: 公司的裁员发生情况得分根据过去三年的裁员人数计算。若裁员影响超过员工总数的 $10\%$ 或超过 1,000 名员工，则评为 10 分。否则不评估裁员发生情况得分，公司特定风险敞口得分仅依据员工总数得分确定。

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Labor Management Exposure Score:

blocks.content_cn: 国际劳工组织；路孚特；MSCI ESG 研究；公司披露。

blocks.content: Correction: The description of the Company-Specific Exposure Score was corrected. Previously, it was omitted that where a company has not experienced a layoff in the last three years, the $LI_{LBM,i}$ is not assessed for that company. and the company-specific exposure score is determined based solely on the $TE_{LBM,i}$ . The formula for the Company-Specific Exposure Score was similarly updated to reflect this.
blocks.content_cn: 更正：修正了公司特定风险敞口得分的说明。此前遗漏了以下情况：若公司过去三年未发生裁员，则不评估该公司的 $LI_{LBM,i}$，公司特定风险敞口得分仅依据 $TE_{LBM,i}$ 确定。相应公式也已更新以反映这一点。
